Math Master.question: ১৪) loga/(y-z)= logb/(z-x)= logc/(x-y) হয়, তবে a<sup>x</sup>b<sup>y</sup>c<sup>z</sup> = কত?

ধরি, loga/(y-z) = logb/(z-x) = logc/(x-y) = k

logb = k(z-x) বা, b = ek(z-x)
logc = k(x-y) বা, c = ek(x-y)
এখন,
axbycz = {ek(y-z)}x. {ek(z-x)}y. {ek(x-y)}z
axbycz = ekxy-kzx+kzy-kxy+kxz-kyz = e0 = 1.
